scientific_integrity: Uniform combinatorial collapse and standard integral Alexander duality; finite computations reproduce representative cases but are not used as an infinite proof. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary three-cut complexes of Möbius ladders with n >= 4; no general result for total cuts, other parameters, shellability, or symmetry representations. Priority against unindexed work cannot be guaranteed.
title: Ordinary three-cut complexes of Möbius ladders are sphere wedges
